content: MK reports that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn does not refer by name to Fażl Allāh Astarābādī or his followers anywhere in his lettrist works, 'perhaps not wishing to dignify them'; the only time he clearly refers to the Ḥurūfiyya is in his second apology (written ca. 832-35/1429-32), where they are described only as “the ringleaders of depravity and sedition” (daftar-i fasād u āshūb).
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka's lettrist works (MK's survey), R. al-Bāʾiyya, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II
